boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free art and regular-season Kenyon athletics for no-purchase outings around Gambier.

cards.title: Browse the Gund Gallery Together
cards.subtitle: Contemporary-art exhibitions in the gallery at Horvitz Hall
cards.notes: Choose a current exhibition, meet inside the Gund and compare one artwork each before making a second pass through the galleries.
cards.short_summary: A free, conversation-ready art outing centered on rotating modern and contemporary exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon states that the Gund Gallery presents rotating exhibitions that are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; consult the Gund Gallery’s current exhibition listings and visitor hours before going.

cards.title: Catch a Kenyon Baseball Game
cards.subtitle: Regular-season baseball at McCloskey Field
cards.notes: Check the baseball schedule, meet near the field before first pitch and settle in for a free regular-season home game.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor game-day hang with innings that leave plenty of time for conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon Athletics identifies McCloskey Field as an athletic facility and states that regular-season home athletic events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free for regular-season home events only. Confirm that the scheduled game is at McCloskey Field; postseason events require paid admission.

cards.title: Watch Basketball at Tomsich Arena
cards.subtitle: Regular-season basketball inside the Lowry Center
cards.notes: Pick a home date on the basketball schedule, gather at the arena entrance and claim seats together before tipoff.
cards.short_summary: A lively indoor option for sharing a game without buying admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon Athletics identifies Tomsich Arena as an athletic facility and states that regular-season home athletic events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free for regular-season home events only. Verify Tomsich Arena on the schedule; conference and NCAA postseason admission is paid.

cards.title: Meet Up for Field Hockey
cards.subtitle: Regular-season field hockey at Benson Bowl
cards.notes: Choose a home match, arrive before the opening whistle and follow the action together from the Benson Bowl sidelines.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket outdoor meetup built around a fast-moving campus match.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon Athletics identifies The Field at Benson Bowl as an athletic facility and states that regular-season home athletic events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free for regular-season home events only. Confirm the venue and status on the field-hockey schedule; postseason events require admission.

cards.title: See a Soccer Match at Mavec Field
cards.subtitle: Regular-season Kenyon soccer in Gambier
cards.notes: Find a home fixture, meet at Mavec Field a few minutes early and choose a viewing spot before the teams walk out.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward outdoor hang organized around ninety minutes of soccer.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon Athletics identifies Mavec Field as an athletic facility and states that regular-season home athletic events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free for regular-season home events only. Check that the fixture is at Mavec Field; conference and NCAA postseason games are ticketed.

cards.title: Spend an Afternoon at Softball
cards.subtitle: Regular-season softball at the Kenyon Softball Complex
cards.notes: Look for a home game or doubleheader, bring weather-ready layers and regroup between innings at the softball complex.
cards.short_summary: A relaxed spring outing where one game—or two—costs nothing to attend.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon Athletics identifies the Kenyon Softball Complex as an athletic facility and states that regular-season home athletic events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free for regular-season home events only. Confirm the complex and any weather changes on the schedule; postseason admission is paid.

cards.title: Cheer at a Swim and Dive Meet
cards.subtitle: Regular-season competition at Steen Aquatic Center
cards.notes: Choose a listed home meet, arrive before the first event and track races and diving rounds together from spectator seating.
cards.short_summary: An indoor, weather-proof hang paced by short races and diving events.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon Athletics identifies Steen Aquatic Center as an athletic facility and states that regular-season home athletic events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free for regular-season home events only. Verify spectator details and the Steen venue; conference and NCAA championships may be ticketed.

cards.title: Follow a Tennis Dual Together
cards.subtitle: Regular-season tennis at Jasper Tennis Center
cards.notes: Check the home slate, meet beside the courts and move between matches as singles and doubles play unfolds.
cards.short_summary: A flexible spectator outing where friends can follow several courts at their own pace.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon Athletics identifies Jasper Tennis Center as an athletic facility and states that regular-season home athletic events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free for regular-season home events only. Confirm the Jasper Tennis Center venue and weather updates; postseason admission may be charged.

cards.title: Drop In on a Track and Field Meet
cards.subtitle: Regular-season track and field at Wilder Track
cards.notes: Use the meet schedule to pick a session, then rotate viewing spots as running, jumping and throwing events progress.
cards.short_summary: A come-and-go campus hang with several competitions happening across one venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon Athletics identifies Wilder Track as an athletic facility and states that regular-season home athletic events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free for regular-season home events only. Confirm that the meet is at Wilder Track; conference and NCAA championship meets are ticketed.

cards.title: Watch a Cross-Country Meet
cards.subtitle: Regular-season racing on Kenyon’s cross-country course
cards.notes: Review the course and meet information, choose a public viewing point and regroup near the finish after runners pass.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal outdoor gathering that turns a campus course into a shared spectator route.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon Athletics identifies the Cross Country Course as an athletic facility and states that regular-season home athletic events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free for regular-season home events only. Consult the meet page for course access and viewing guidance; postseason admission may differ.
